verdict.rationale: Fern's domain setup docs say you can serve docs on a subdomain (docs.mydomain.com), a subpath (mydomain.com/docs) or a root domain (mydomain.com), which covers both halves of the story. The evidence is first-party only and states the option without setup detail. Missing for 10: documented setup steps (DNS or reverse-proxy configuration for subpath hosting), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a DevRel lead, I serve docs on my own custom domain or as a /docs subpath of my main site

citations.quote: You can configure any of the following custom domain types: Subdomain: `docs.mydomain.com`, Subpath: `mydomain.com/docs`, Root domain: `mydomain.com`
